name: Cutout
reference: Saul Bass title sequences (Anatomy of a Murder, North by Northwest): cut paper, one hot colour.
pattern: Off-white paper, black cut shapes, one hot orange-red.
personality: One idea per shape. Flat cut paper slides, rotates and builds the title.

motion.character: Sharp moves, a stepped 12 fps feel, shapes sliding in from the frame edge.
motion.transitions: A black shape wipes across and becomes the next shape.

grammar: Type is angled and fitted into shapes.
One hot colour, used once per frame.

exceptions.reason: Saul Bass's palette is the reference itself: off-white stock, black and one orange-red, used as hard-edged cut paper, never as a soft UI accent.

pictures.note: A subject becomes flat cut paper in three tones (ink, the orange, paper), like the shapes, never a photograph.

footage.note: No footage: the shapes move, not a camera.

music.feel: big-band jazz, bongos and brass stabs, cool and tense

hits.note: A paper slide (soft whoosh) when a shape crosses; a stamp when the title locks.

hook.how: A black slab enters on frame 0 with the first word of the main line already fitted into it, cropped by the slab's edges.

compose.how: The slab is the subject: a cut shape at the hook's share (heroBox, a graphic), and the line is fitted into it (fitText: ground on the ink slab, onAccent on the hot slab), as large as the slab allows, angled with it. Never a line stacked above a shape. The hot colour once in the frame: the slab that carries the word.

moves.move: Type is fitted into the shapes, as large as the slab allows, angled with it.
A black shape wipes across and becomes the next shape: the panel holds full cover for 2 frames at most.

measurable.how: No run of more than 2 frames in one flat colour.

moves.move: Shapes slide in from the frame edge on a stepped 12 fps feel, fully opaque.

measurable.how: No sliding shape is at partial opacity.

moves.move: One hot colour, used once per frame, as the action.

measurable.how: The accent covers one connected region per key frame.

props.fill: "accent" for the one hot slab (the action, once a frame), "ink" for the rest

props.direction: the travel of the next shape

blocks.for: The black shape that becomes the next frame.
A paper slide on each crossing, a stamp when the title locks.

props.color: "ground" on the ink slab, "onAccent" on an accent slab (ink on ink does not show)
props.x: the slab's box (x, y, w, h)

blocks.for: The largest type inside a slab.

props.lines: 2 for a title of three words or more

blocks.for: The title as one cut: words at one size in one slab.

props.paper: true (the subject as a two-tone paper cut; needs the cut-out from prepare)

blocks.for: A picture (rare): a cut-out as flat cut paper, cropped to a shape, small in a large empty field. Never a graded photograph at full size.

avoid.why: Cut paper does not plot data.

wanted.name: fitText in a tilted band
wanted.for: The largest type inside a tilted band or a polygon; fitText fills an upright box only.

ends.how: The title locks as one lockup on the bar, with a stamp, and holds.
ends.with: `axis: "row"`, `at` on the bar, with a stamp from `hit`

mix.note: Big-band and tense. The busiest picture goes on the busiest bars.

shots.match: One silhouette per subject, in two tones, cut as paper.

subjectsToAvoid: Fibonacci numbers or the golden spiral
FizzBuzz or a sort of ten numbers
a generic movie title with no story
